_comment: Copy this file to /etc/wifi-monitor/config.json and edit before starting the service.

my_networks._comment: Add one entry per SSID you own. Classification=mine will be applied to any AP advertising these SSIDs.

_comment_bssid: Optional: OUI prefixes (first 3 octets) of your AP hardware for additional classification confidence.
_comment_hec: Full HEC URL including port and path. Self-signed certs are handled with curl -k.
_comment_token: HEC token. Create in Splunk: Settings > Data Inputs > HTTP Event Collector > New Token.
_comment_interval: Scan interval in seconds. 60 is recommended. Minimum practical value is 30.
_comment_location: Freeform tag added to every event. Useful if you deploy multiple collectors.
_comment_radios: Interface names for each band. Verify with: iw dev
